module: Flowgraph node "File Path" (category once_p_duration, tag scenario). Loads a race path (.race.json file) into a gameplay/race/path object, deserializes it, reverses it if requested, calls autoConfig() and publishes it. Inputs: file (string, path with or without .race.json, resolved by mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath), reverse (bool). Outputs: pathData ('pathData' table for the other race nodes), name, desc, branching, closed, laps (default laps), checkpointCount (number of sorted pathnodes) and recoveryCount (pathnodes with a recovery point, depending on direction). Loading happens only once (as long as self.path is nil).
notes: If the file cannot be found, a node error is set on the 'file' pin.
In the editor, the properties panel offers to open the Race Editor and to hardcode the opened file into the file pin.
The description of checkpointCount states that the count does not work for branching paths.

init.desc: Initializes self.path to nil and disables clearOutPinsOnStart.

postInit.desc: Restricts the file selector of the 'file' pin to "Race Files" (.race.json).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor properties panel: button to open the Race Editor, name of the opened file and "Hardcode to File Pin" button.

onNodeReset.desc: Forgets the loaded path (self.path = nil) to force a reload.

_executionStopped.desc: Forgets the loaded path when the graph stops.

work.desc: Loads the race file if it is not loaded yet, applies reverse/autoConfig and fills all output pins.
